newExactHeadFindings.title: Enforce the sidecar at material activation
newExactHeadFindings.body: When a later reviewed source installs TRUSTED_CENTRAL_ACTIVATION, deleting or altering this sidecar still does not block material execution: execute() calls consume_source() and verify_activation(), but neither reads REVIEW01_SIDECAR, validates its required bindings, or requires its hash in the activation record. Thus this newly declared receiptAbsenceBlocksAcceptanceAndActivation condition is only metadata, and execution can proceed without the successful receipt that is supposed to bind the final freeze and eight leaves. Bind and verify the sidecar identity and contents before execute_material() is reachable.
